name: obsidian-keep-lists
description: Google Keep-style checklists: drag to reorder, drag right to nest, checked items move to a completed section.

scripts.install-vault: test -n "$VAULT" || { echo 'Set VAULT to your vault folder'; exit 1; }; npm run build && mkdir -p "$VAULT/.obsidian/plugins/keep-lists" && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "$VAULT/.obsidian/plugins/keep-lists/"
